fact: Gabon's Budget Minister launched on 27 December 2021 the digital Journal des marchés publics at lejmp.ga, which publishes tender notices and results online and offers tender document downloads.

The Ministry of Economy and Finance launched SIGFiP on 15 January 2026, to handle public procurement among all revenue and spending operations; some procurement modules are functional and development of the others continues.

The amended Digital Gabon financing agreement (effective 2 September 2026) finances the design and implementation of an e-Government Procurement system covering planning to delivery and linked with government payment systems.
The Ministry of Economy and Finance says public procurement management is among the SIGFiP module 1 functions developed to date and due to be deployed from early January 2026.
